reference.source: Parsons' Diseases of the Eye 23rd Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Itch means allergy, pus means bacteria
Trachoma scars upper lids: SAFE it
Pterygium crosses limbus, pinguecula does not
reference.pathophysiology: Chlamydial elementary bodies provoke follicular lymphoid hyperplasia with papillary hypertrophy, and repeated healing contracts tarsal conjunctiva, rotating lashes inward to abrade cornea into opacification; UV elastosis degenerates interpalpebral collagen into wing shaped fibrovascular ingrowth.
additionalDifferentials: Bacterial versus viral by discharge and nodes
Trachoma versus other follicular disease by upper tarsal scarring
Pinguecula versus pterygium by limbus crossing
additionalInvestigations: Slit lamp with fluorescein and eversion
Conjunctival swab or chlamydial testing by pattern
Vitamin A and autoimmune review in surface failure
